controls.title: Protected and tested backups
controls.objective: Backups of critical data are protected from tampering (offline or immutable) and restores are tested.

questions.text: Is at least one copy of critical backups offline or immutable, and separated from production credentials?
questions.guidance: Partial: backups exist but all reachable with domain admin credentials.

questions.text: Months since the last successful test restore of a critical system

references.source: NIST CSWP 29, The NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0
references.note: wording to be checked against CSWP 29

controls.title: Recovery plan and objectives
controls.objective: Recovery procedures and recovery time objectives are defined for critical services.

questions.text: Are recovery time objectives defined for each critical service and recovery procedures documented?
Measured recovery time of a critical service in the last recovery test, as a percentage of its RTO
questions.guidance: 100 percent or less means the RTO was met.

references.source: NIST CSWP 29, The NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0
references.note: wording to be checked against CSWP 29

controls.title: Restoration verification and closure
controls.objective: Restored systems are verified before return to service and recovery closure is documented.

questions.text: Does the recovery procedure require integrity checks of restored systems and a documented declaration that recovery has ended?

references.source: NIST CSWP 29, The NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0
references.note: wording to be checked against CSWP 29

controls.title: Recovery communications
controls.objective: Recovery progress is communicated internally and publicly through approved channels.

questions.text: Are there pre-approved internal and public communication templates and a named spokesperson for recovery updates?
questions.guidance: Partial: templates without approval or spokesperson.

references.source: NIST CSWP 29, The NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0
references.note: wording to be checked against CSWP 29
